description: ProductGateway (persistence) imports the OrderItem type from the business OrderService for hasStockFor(items); OrderService already imports ProductGateway, so the upward edge closes a cross-layer cycle.

expectedFindings.reason: Two-file import cycle OrderService -> ProductGateway -> OrderService across business and persistence.
A lower layer (persistence) imports an upper one (business).
persistence > business is not an allowed transition (only business > persistence and presentation > business are).
